bottom_line: In the combined EURIDIS/ADONIS trials, dronedarone vs placebo reduced recurrence of atrial fibrillation at 12 months (hazard ratio, 0.75; 95% CI, 0.65 to 0.87).
implications: These trials support that, compared with placebo, dronedarone prolonged time to first recurrence and reduced recurrence at 12 months in the combined analysis (hazard ratio, 0.75; 95% CI, 0.65 to 0.87; recurrence rates 64.1% vs 75.2%). The document also reports lower ventricular rate at first recurrence and a higher incidence of elevated serum creatinine with dronedarone (2.4% vs 0.2%). The document states the efficacy and adverse-event rates cannot be stated with certainty vs amiodarone because it was not directly compared.

major_points.text: Primary endpoint was time to first documented recurrence of atrial fibrillation or flutter.
major_points.quote: The primary end point was the time to the first recurrence of atrial fibrillation or flutter.

major_points.text: Modified intention-to-treat analysis included all randomized patients who received at least one dose of study drug.
major_points.quote: The primary analysis was performed according to a modified intention-to-treat principle, with all ran- domized patients who received at least one dose of a study drug included.

major_points.text: In the combined trials, median time to first recurrence was longer with dronedarone vs placebo (116 vs 53 days).
major_points.quote: For the two trials combined, the median times to a documented recurrence of atrial fibrillation were 116 days in the dronedarone group and 53 days in the placebo group.

major_points.text: At first recurrence, ventricular rate was lower with dronedarone vs placebo in both trials.
major_points.quote: In the European trial, the mean (±SD) ventricular rate during the first adjudicated recurrence was 102.3±24.7 beats per minute in the dronedarone group and 117.5±29.1 beats per min- ute in the placebo group (P<0.001).

major_points.text: Elevation of serum creatinine occurred more often with dronedarone than placebo.
major_points.quote: there was a higher incidence of ele- vated serum creatinine levels in the dronedarone group than in the placebo group (2.4% vs. 0.2%, P = 0.004).

absolute_effects.text: Combined trials recurrence rate at 12 months: 75.2% placebo vs 64.1% dronedarone.
European trial median time to first recurrence: 41 days placebo vs 96 days dronedarone.
Non-European trial median time to first recurrence: 59 days placebo vs 158 days dronedarone.
Hospitalization or death (combined): 30.9% placebo vs 22.8% dronedarone.

subgroups.text: Effect was consistent for clinically important subgroups (figure referenced).
subgroups.quote: was consistent for a series of clini- cally important subgroups (Fig. 3).

harms.text: Death from any cause: 8 (1.0) with dronedarone vs 3 (0.7) with placebo.
Stroke: 4 (0.5) with dronedarone vs 3 (0.7) with placebo.
Elevation of serum creatinine: 20 (2.4) with dronedarone vs 1 (0.2) with placebo.
Ventricular arrhythmia: 6 (0.7) with dronedarone vs 2 (0.5) with placebo.
In the European trial, 67 dronedarone and 25 placebo patients discontinued the study prematurely.
harms.quote: In the European trial, 67 patients in the dronedarone              group and 25 in the placebo group discontinued              the study prematurely;

harms.text: In the non-European trial, 81 dronedarone and 36 placebo patients discontinued the study prematurely.

inclusion_criteria.text: Patients were of either sex and at least 21 years of age.
inclusion_criteria.quote: Patients qualifying for enrollment were of either sex and at least 21 years of age

inclusion_criteria.text: Patients had at least one episode of atrial fibrillation on ECG in the preceding 3 months.
inclusion_criteria.quote: had had at least one episode of atrial fibrillation (as seen on elec- trocardiography) in the preceding 3 months

inclusion_criteria.text: Patients were in sinus rhythm for at least 1 hour before randomization.
inclusion_criteria.quote: and were in sinus rhythm for at least 1 hour before randomization.

exclusion_criteria.text: Permanent atrial fibrillation (duration of at least 12 months) was excluded.
exclusion_criteria.quote: Excluded from the study were pa- tients with permanent atrial fibrillation (i.e., a duration of at least 12 months)

exclusion_criteria.text: PR interval of 0.28 second or more was excluded.
exclusion_criteria.quote: a PR interval of 0.28 second or more on electrocardiography

exclusion_criteria.text: NYHA class III or IV congestive heart failure was excluded.
exclusion_criteria.quote: patients with New York Heart Association class III or IV conges- tive heart failure

exclusion_criteria.quote: patients with a serum cre- atinine level of 1.7 mg per deciliter (150 μmol per liter) or more

analysis_methods.text: Patients were randomly assigned 2:1 to dronedarone vs placebo.
analysis_methods.quote: were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to receive either 400 mg of oral dronedarone twice daily or a matching placebo.

analysis_methods.text: Each trial planned for 90% power to detect a between-group difference, assuming 20% dropout and 1-year follow-up.
analysis_methods.quote: each trial would have a power of 90% to detect a between-group difference, assuming a 20% dropout rate and a 1-year follow-up period.

analysis_methods.text: Primary analysis used a modified intention-to-treat principle including all randomized patients who received at least one dose.
analysis_methods.quote: The primary analysis was performed according to a modified intention-to-treat principle, with all ran- domized patients who received at least one dose of a study drug included.

analysis_methods.text: Log-rank test used to test identical Kaplan–Meier curves between groups.
analysis_methods.quote: A standard log-rank technique was used to test the null hy- pothesis of identical Kaplan–Meier curves in the two study groups.

analysis_methods.text: Fisher’s exact test used for qualitative measures.
analysis_methods.quote: A two-sided Fisher’s exact test was used for qualitative mea- sures.

analysis_methods.text: Kaplan–Meier technique estimated event-free probability curves with 95% confidence intervals.
analysis_methods.quote: The event-free probability curves were es- timated by the nonparametric Kaplan–Meier tech- nique, with 95% confidence intervals.

criticisms.text: The trial likely did not detect every episode of recurrent arrhythmia.
criticisms.quote: it is likely that we were not able to detect every episode of recur- rent arrhythmia in our study patients.

criticisms.text: Continuous monitoring over the long term was beyond the scope of the trials.
criticisms.quote: Continuous monitoring of all study patients over the long term was beyond the scope of these trials

criticisms.text: The trial design did not permit a clear distinction between persistent and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
criticisms.quote: the trial design did not per- mit a clear distinction between patients who had persistent atrial fibrillation and those with parox- ysmal atrial fibrillation.

criticisms.text: Dronedarone was not directly compared with amiodarone, limiting certainty about comparative efficacy and adverse-event rates.
criticisms.quote: In neither of the trials did we directly compare dronedarone with amiodarone. Therefore, we can- not be certain that the efficacy of dronedarone is similar to that of amiodarone

criticisms.text: Low pulmonary toxicity rates may be partly explained by short trial duration and limited pulmonary testing unless symptomatic.
criticisms.quote: the low rate of adverse events (espe- cially pulmonary toxic effects) may be explained in part by the relatively short duration of our trials and by the fact that chest radiography and assess- ment of pulmonary function were not performed unless symptoms were present.
